correctness.rationale: Using traceless diagonal 4x4 operator completeness in the qubit-register Hilbert–Schmidt discord formula, the classical-register centering terms cancel and G=(1/4)sum_a r_a r_a^T. For four unit Bloch vectors tr(G)=1, so lambda_max(G)>=1/3 and D_G<=(1/8)(1-1/3)=1/12. Equality RR^T=4I/3 implies I-(3/4)R^TR=ss^T/4 with s_a in ±1, so all maximizers are signed regular tetrahedra; this handles the continuous Bloch optimization. The two QRAC Walsh vectors have norm squared (16-(w·s)^2)/3<=16/3; measurement optimization gives P_av<=1/2+1/(2sqrt(3)), attained at unflipped tetrahedron; this is below optimal 1/2+1/(2sqrt(2)). Independently replayed exact rational Gram and sixteen sign choices; sign enumeration only after proof reduces all continuous maximizers.
